newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa says closing offshore acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Absa says closing offshore acquisition.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) said on Monday that it was close to finalising the purchase of a controlling stake in an offshore investment firm.

"We are well advanced in negotiations to acquire a controlling interest in a well-established offshore group, providing international trust and investment advisory services," chief executive Danie Cronje told an analyst briefing.
"If successful, and I think it's probably 90 percent completed, this acquisition will provide us with immediate capabilities in a range of offshore trust and investment services," he added.
Cronje told Reuters the purchase should be finalised in June.
He said Absa was making the move in order to tap high net worth clients who wished to take advantage of the loosening of South African exchange controls.
"We're scratching at the top end, the private banking client, the rich individual," he added.
Cronje declined to elaborate on the size of the deal but market sources said it was likely to be in the order of 100 million rand.
Absa earlier announced a 24.8 percent rise in 1996/97 headline earnings per share to 222.2 cents.
